[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Husk''' was a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] who participated in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Husk was the leader of [[Aurek Squad (Galactic Republic)|Aurek Squad]], a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of four clone commandos. During the Clone Wars, Husk and his squad traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tirahnn/Legends|Tirahnn]] in a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/stealth/Legends|LAAT/s]] to carry out a mission there in preparation for a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] attack. They arrived on the planet undetected by the orbiting [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], but were forced to crash-land due to unforeseen weather conditions. They were then attacked by a [[Roggwart/Legends|roggwart]], but were able to kill the creature.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />

Afterwards, Husk and the commandos set out on [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]] and carried out their primary objective, the sabotage of the main CIS vehicle depot on the planet. Shortly afterwards, the Republic began its [[Battle of Tirahnn (Clone Wars)|main attack]] and Husk and the other commandos succeeded in blocking the main escape route for the Confederacy troops. He then used his [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] to contact a group of Republic agents and asked them to block off a secondary escape route by destroying a bridge.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
